title: Sedition
reason: Omitted. The colonial offence of sedition was formally dropped in the BNS. In its place, BNS Section 152 penalizes acts endangering sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India without using the term 'sedition'.
status: Omitted as colonial offence (Replaced conceptually by BNS 152)

title: Attempt to commit suicide
reason: Substantially dropped. Ordinary attempt to commit suicide is decriminalized in line with Section 115 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017. BNS Section 226 only penalizes suicide attempts made specifically to compel or restrain a public servant from discharging official duty.

title: Thug
reason: Omitted. Archaic colonial provision originally aimed at historical highway gangs; modern organized criminal syndicates are now governed by BNS Section 111.
status: Omitted as Obsolete (Organized crime now in BNS 111)

title: Unnatural offences
reason: Substantially dropped. Consensual adult sexual acts were decriminalized by the Supreme Court in Navtej Singh Johar (2018). Non-consensual acts, bestiality, and sexual assault against persons and minors are prosecuted under BNS rape provisions and the POCSO Act.
status: Omitted / Struck Down by Supreme Court

title: Adultery
reason: Omitted. Unanimously struck down as unconstitutional, gender-discriminatory, and violative of Articles 14 and 21 by the Supreme Court in Joseph Shine v. Union of India (2018). Completely discarded in BNS.

title: Enticing or taking away or detaining with criminal intent a married woman
reason: Omitted. Archaic provision treating married women as the proprietary chattel of the husband; removed to uphold gender equality.

title: Abetting in India the counterfeiting out of India of coin
reason: Omitted. Colonial distinction of Queen's/King's coin vs foreign coins consolidated into unified currency notes and coin provisions (BNS 178-188).

title: Import or export of counterfeits of the Queen's coin
reason: Omitted as obsolete colonial monarchical coinage provision.

title: Person employed in mint causing coin to be of different weight or composition from that fixed by law
reason: Omitted. Regulated under special mint, coinage, and Reserve Bank administrative legislation.

title: Unlawfully taking coining instrument from mint
reason: Omitted. Governed by specific security and Coinage Acts.

title: Lurking house-trespass by night
reason: Consolidated into BNS Section 331 (House-trespass or house-breaking by night).

title: House-breaking by night
reason: Consolidated into BNS Section 331 (House-trespass or house-breaking by night).
